subject: Re: Redwood procurement & onboarding — PO and stakeholder mapping

Subject: Redwood procurement & onboarding — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the thoughtful discussion on Acme's integration needs and procurement timeline. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can align with your teams:

Call recap:
- Primary use case: real-time fraud scoring for payments; latency and cost are top priorities.
- Expected initial volume: ~50M tokens/month, ramp to 150M over Q3.
- Success criteria: <200ms P95 for generation flows, under $0.002 per 1k tokens after batching/quantization.

Stakeholder map (from the call):
- Product/AI: Samantha Lee (you) — owner of technical requirements
- Security/Legal: TBD (we discussed internal legal review)
- Procurement/Billing: TBD
- Economic buyer: CFO (you mentioned Mark Johnson)

Proposed next steps:
1) Please share procurement contact and PO process (billing email, invoice cadence, any PO template).
2) Security / legal questionnaire — we'll send the standard packet; if you have a vendor onboarding form, please attach.
3) Draft SOW & pricing: attaching a short SOW template for your review (Redwood_SOW_template.pdf).
4) Target timeline: if procurement can issue PO by May 14 we can kickoff onboarding the week of May 20.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_template.pdf (draft SOW + pricing grid)

If you prefer I can loop in our legal lead (Priyom) and billing to accelerate the vendor forms. Let me know the best procurement contact and any specific invoice/PO requirements.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

3) Tax & W-9: we will provide our W-9 inside the vendor packet; if you need a different tax form let me know.
4) Timeline: if we receive a signed PO by EOD May 14, we can schedule onboarding kickoff for the week of May 20 and target an initial pilot by June 1 as discussed.

Open items for you:
- Please confirm procurement contact (Emily confirmed) and the PO format (any special fields your AP system needs).
- Please confirm whether Acme requires any vendor-specific insurance or additional attachments.
